propositions: When a single criterion's evidence run exhausts its LLM budget, the entire bounded recovery fails instead of preserving partial evidence from other criteria.

Budget exhaustion errors (LLMBudgetExhaustedError, RunawayToolLoopError, token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError) in per-criterion evidence loops propagate immediately and abort recovery, rather than being caught and replaced with content-free placeholders.
Recovery should only fail outright when all criteria's evidence runs fail; individual criterion budget exhaustion must be handled as unverifiable-within-bounds and passed to the finalizer.

The finalizer must receive N evidence entries for N criteria even when some evidence runs exhaust, with exhausted entries marked with an explicit could-not-gather-within-bounds placeholder that cannot be interpreted as affirmative evidence.
